title: deenpro1 PvP
description: This is a remix of PvP Scroutopia by Scroutop with some improvements for a good time while pvping!
body:
# deenpro1 pvp pack
This is the pvp pack i use myself. It is a remix of PvP Scroutopia by Scroutop. I changed:
- Totem
- Sword size
- Fire hight
- Removed highlighted ores (but diamonds)

  You can visit the original pack [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pvp-).

This project is a modified version of PvP Scroutopia by Scroutop.
